exposure: In Vitro Fertilization and Embryo Transfer
In Vitro Fertilization and Embryo Transfer (IVF-ET)
cohort: 130 pregnant women who conceived through IVF-ET
finding: A large number of pregnancies conceived through IVF-ET terminated in vaginal delivery, indicating that these pregnancies, though high risk, can have vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: A large number of pregnancies terminated in vaginal delivery.
